name: Why choose a low-profile threshold over a standard one?

mainEntity.name: Why choose a low-profile threshold over a standard one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Low-profile thresholds are preferred for their accessibility benefits, making entry and exit easier for individuals with mobility challenges, children, and pets. They also offer a cleaner, more modern aesthetic by minimizing the visual interruption at the doorway. Unlike standard thresholds that can create a noticeable bump, low-profile options provide a smoother transition, enhancing safety and overall design continuity within your home or business.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a low-profile threshold for improved accessibility, reduced trip hazards, and a modern aesthetic.
